assumptions: Synthetic aggregate coefficients, not demographic/engineering norms
Water is an external boundary supply; deposits and initial assets/stocks are explicit
Training places represent consenting eligible capacity, not people owned or traded
Qualified capacity and equipment are shared use limits, not consumed ingredients
Public asset procurement is paid only for completed equipment/buildings
Input payments follow actual consumption; incomplete work ties up opening working measure
Natural resources and people have zero commodity price in this example
All monetary norms fixed; no interest, tax, loan or later issuance
Actual missing provision remains recorded; no claim that missing goods cancel human entitlements
Money is prefunded using exact schedule bounds, not optimized globally
Inventory age/expiry, health demography, individual choice, teacher specializations and foreign trade remain open
Heuristic is not a global optimum except when a valid stated objective certificate exists

withdrawals.basis: Synthetic withdrawal of qualified availability; not loss of human rights
